layer1.price: 0.01 USD fixed (x402 exact / mpp charge, Base USDC)
layer1.credential_boundary: Accepts no credentials, wallet or resource IDs, counter values, signatures, transactions, or raw provider responses

layer2.execution_model: independent execution of the verbatim source revision against a recording mock wallet + policy fakes; blob-hash provenance; offline

mapping.rationale: Allow-path execution with exact allocation binding: a single decision executes exactly the evaluated recipient+amount (F1); gasless allow binds the EIP-3009 signature to exactly the evaluated message (F12).

Deny mechanism proven by independent execution (policy denial fails before any wallet contact, F2/F13; second use of a consumed decision_ref denied with exactly one spend, F10). The specific cumulative-limit control is policy configuration, not a fixture-verified policy object: the fixture's policy provider is a fake. A stateful pass would add an explicit cumulative-limit policy case.

Authority-bound consumption immediately before requesting the EIP-3009 signature: the decision_ref is consumed before signing, so a signature that is produced but not yet relayed still counts against the decision (F14: no second signature). A rejected signTypedData proves signing was attempted; the ref is conservatively retained. This is post-sign accounting at the authority level, verified against the verbatim implementation and re-confirmed by the maintainer at the diff level (osr21, 2026-08-26/27).

The fixture tests the action-provider surface (schemas, hashing, consumption, classification), not calldata/ABI extraction integrity. No independent-execution evidence exists for this control. Explicit gap: a stateful conformance pass for a wallet provider would need to add extraction-integrity cases.

Concurrent duplicate submissions are blocked by the pending-set before any wallet contact; exactly one spend (F11). Sequential replay also denied (F10). Maintainer-confirmed at the diff level (osr21: 'pending continues to guard concurrent reuse until finally releases it').

At the decision-ref level: a missing decision_ref fails before wallet contact (F3); action_context_hash and decision_ref recompute from stored fields alone and the join holds (F6, F16b). Caveat: the fixture's reference is a decision-ref join key, not a spend-counter; counters live in the policy fake. The reference-integrity property is proven at the authority-boundary level.

The fixture's pending-set is provider-level, process-local, in-memory (per osr21's packaging note: no cross-instance semantics). No application-level serialization layer is tested. Explicit gap and consistent with the fixture's own limits.

summary.falsifiable_claim: Lumen's layer-2 independent execution speaks the layer-1 stateful taxonomy for 4 of 7 controls (allow-path binding, post-sign accounting, concurrency, reference integrity), partially for cumulative limits, and not at all for extraction integrity and application serialization. A fixed-price stateful-conformance pass would scope to the 2 gaps plus the partial.

provenance.note: Mapping is a property-level correspondence, not an endorsement that the two products test identical artifacts: layer 1 scores operator-supplied observations; layer 2 executes the verbatim implementation. The mapping makes the two-layer composition contract explicit so both authorities stay separate.
